Practitioner for help with weight loss. She says she has been avoiding fried foods 
and has switched to low-fat milk. Which of the following stages of change does 
FM exhibit in the Transtheoretical Model?
a. Pre-contemplation
b. Contemplation
c. Action
d. Regret
